desc:
Villa Rica Testing Ground: the chassis VR will use in the main game. Paid experience with a small BeamNG-style grid map for chassis testing and messing around with friends. More will be added, but not a lot. Not a roleplay game!

Starting the Car!

PC: F = Accessories | Hold S + F = Engine On | Hold F = Quiet Start
Console: Triangle + Brake or Hold Triangle
Mobile: Double tap power button (or hold it / hold Brake + tap)

PC: WASD drive, E shift up, Q shift down, U = disable AEB
Click "Comfort" under the gear to cycle Comfort/Sport/Eco

CONSOLE (PS4/PS5)
Circle Horn | Square Seatbelt | X Jump/TCS | R3 Drive Mode
D-Pad: Left/Right Blinkers, Down Lights, Up Hazards
L1/R1 Shift | L2 Brake | R2 Gas

MOBILE: +/- on the left to shift
